headline: Sheetal Cool Products announces 5:1 bonus issue and 1:2 stock split
hook: Bonus shares and stock split proposed

modes.bear: Corporate actions do not alter the underlying business value, and excessive hype can lead to short-term volatility without fundamental changes.
modes.bull: Bonus issues and stock splits increase liquidity and make shares more accessible to retail buyers, reflecting strong management confidence.
modes.simple: This company is dividing its existing shares into smaller pieces and giving extra shares to current owners as a reward, but you need to wait for official dates.

summary: Ice-cream maker Sheetal Cool Products has recommended a 5:1 bonus issue and a 1:2 stock split, pending shareholder and regulatory approvals. The company has not yet announced the record dates for these corporate actions. The stock recently closed 1.11% higher, reflecting an 11.39% gain over the past week following strong historical returns. Retail investors holding the stock should note that final execution depends on upcoming approvals and the announcement of record dates.
whats_next: Announcement of record dates and shareholder approval
why_it_matters: Record dates and approvals pending for your holdings

headline: Sheetal Cool Products board approves 5:1 bonus issue

modes.bear: Bonus issues do not create fundamental underlying value; the stock price will drop proportionally after the ex-date, diluting per-share metrics.
modes.bull: A 5:1 bonus issue reflects strong internal reserves and management confidence, increasing share liquidity and accessibility for retail investors.
modes.simple: The company is giving you five extra shares for every one share you already own, which makes the stock more affordable for new buyers.

summary: Sheetal Cool Products Limited announced that its board of directors approved a bonus issue of 5 equity shares for every 1 existing equity share held. The decision was made during the board meeting held on November 12, 2026. This corporate action significantly increases the total number of shares in circulation for the company. For retail investors holding the stock, this expands their shareholding quantity proportionately.
why_it_matters: Your share count multiplies fivefold at adjusted prices

headline: Sheetal Cool Products board approves stock split from Rs 10 to Rs 5
hook: Face value halves for Sheetal Cool holders

modes.bear: A stock split is purely cosmetic and does not change the fundamental underlying business value or earnings.
modes.bull: Stock splits can improve overall trading liquidity by lowering the nominal price per share for retail investors.
modes.simple: The company is splitting every one of its shares into two, cutting the price of each share in half while you get twice as many shares, so your total investment remains the same.

summary: Sheetal Cool Products Limited announced that its board of directors has approved a stock split during a meeting held on November 12, 2026. One existing equity share with a face value of Rs 10 will be subdivided into two equity shares with a face value of Rs 5 each. This corporate action alters the nominal value of the shares without changing the underlying value of the company for retail investors.
whats_next: Company to announce record date for the stock split.
why_it_matters: Share price halves while holding count doubles, leaving total investment value unchanged.
